# Tailormade
Customize your clothing freely with the Tailormade Mod! This mod allows you to design original skins using an in-game editor and attach them directly to your _armor_.  
  
**Notice**: This mod is still in its **early alpha stages**, so it may contain bugs or unexpected behaviors.   
Please back up your worlds just in case!   
Any bug reports and suggestions to improve the mod are always welcome!

## Features

*   **In-Game Clothing Design**: Instantly replace the appearance of your armor with skins designed entirely in-game.
*   **Style Meets Substance**: Change only the visual look of your gear while keeping all the vanilla stats and perks of your armor!
*   **Easy Reversibility**: By simply using a Bleach, you can strip the custom texture away and revert it back to standard armor.

## Added Items

*   **Hat Pattern**: A clothing pattern used to edit the skin layer for your head.
*   **Shirt Pattern**: A clothing pattern used to edit the skin layer for your torso and arms.
*   **Pants Pattern**: A clothing pattern used to edit the skin layer for your legs.
*   **Shoes Pattern**: A clothing pattern used to edit the skin layer for your feet.
*   **Bleach**: An item to un-dye tailored armor, can be crafted with a Water Bucket, Nether Quartz, and Redstone.

\*All patterns can be crafted with a paper and a black dye, and interchangeable for each other.

## Added Blocks

### 🧵 The Crafting Stations

*   **Design Table**: Insert a pattern here to open the custom pixel editor and sketch your design for that specific clothing piece.
*   **Tailoring Station**: Combine a completed pattern, a matching piece of armor, and the required dyes (Red, Green, Blue) to apply your custom design to the gear.
*   **Bleaching Counter**: Craft a bleach and use this station to safely restore tailored armor to its original, un-dyed form.

### 👗 Wardrobe & Display

*   **Dresser**: A dedicated design editor for customizing your inner skin layer. This layer will seamlessly render beneath any exposed or cut-out areas of your custom clothing.
*   **Wardrobe**: A specialized GUI block where you can choose and fine-tune your underwear style and color palette.
*   **Mannequin**: A display stand to showcase your original designs.
